notes.title: Customisation Update !
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32707816/7b65f209fdfbd5150458f80653302ed20c0318c9.jpg

Supralympic Runners has now:

an XP system: the more you run, the more you run!
Uracoins! It's the runner money. You get it reaching checkpoints, and multiply them with collectibles during the races!
a freakin WORKSHOP where you can use Uracoins to customise your runner with high-performance and expensive gears!
a deep variation of every physical aspects of the game though the gears: resilience, impulse, density,  aerodynamics, etc.
a better slow down system: separated from the slow motion, it's now a full feature by itself. When you slow down, you get back some dash power to get back your speed afterward!
a better vertical control: you can plane very smoothly when holding the jump button, and can get back to the ground faster. You can control your jump lenght!

We kinda drive away from a classical endless runner to steal some ideas from sports cars games - however Supalympics stays an arcade game. The customisation update is the biggest update we wanted to make before the release. Can you feel the heat?!
